gen-gf-playpen-sans-thai-sora: Jotted-down and friendly: that is Playpen Sans Thai. Sora sits beneath it, precise and geometric, with curves that turn corners without swelling, a quality that makes short bursts of text easy to take in.
gen-gf-potta-one-fs-rowan: Potta One draws wire-like monoline letters spaced extra wide. Rowan, a literary serif with open curves and visible thick-thin modulation, is pleasant in modest helpings, while the heading earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-princess-sofia-fs-fira-sans: Graceful and casual, Princess Sofia huddles its deep-bellied lowercase together with barely any gap. And Fira Sans, with no stroke contrast and a generous x-height, settles into text easily when taken in modest sips.
gen-gf-princess-sofia-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp and a little heavy, a dark strip of text with letters held open rather than curled shut. Princess Sofia lightens it, and reading goes best a little at a time.
gen-gf-princess-sofia-general-sans: Soft, huddled handwriting: Princess Sofia has a deep-bellied lowercase, while General Sans fills the line with a tall x-height. Steady pressure and smooth bends keep text gliding, gentlest in small helpings.
gen-gf-princess-sofia-manrope: Manrope draws a bright opening in every curve at a single line width, while Princess Sofia leans hand-drawn and graceful. Smooth, uniform line against loose handwriting is the draw, made for brief reading.
gen-gf-protest-revolution-fs-paquito: Protest Revolution is bold, with lighter diagonals and big open counters. But Paquito, a confident serif with a minimal gap between lowercase and caps, is happiest with a few lines rather than pages.
gen-gf-quintessential-fs-bespoke-sans: Graceful and personal, Quintessential jams its handwritten letters together like stamped metal slugs. Bespoke Sans handles the sharp, refined detail, while the heading carries the personality, best taken in small portions.
gen-gf-quintessential-fs-literata: Tight-packed handwriting, graceful and personal: Quintessential crowds its letters like metal slugs. But Literata, bookish and sturdy with open-mouthed curves, carries a run of text comfortably, though brevity suits the pair best.
gen-gf-raleway-dots-fs-gambetta: Heavy stems against hairline strokes: Raleway Dots turns the volume up. Gambetta brings bookish grace, with wide channels into each counter and gentle weight shifts, best sampled lightly, while the heading does the shouting.
